title: Evaluate libsail for parsing and indexing nail's inputs
body:
Decide whether libsail replaces nail's own fasta and p7hmm parsing and indexing (nail/src/io/). Blocks the serial-overhead work under this milestone, since the target db write, the profile parse and the index passes are all built on that code.

What the current code does, for comparison: a single-threaded index pass in 1 MiB reads, line by line, with a strum string match per line for HMM files and an IndexMap<String, Offset> keyed by name; records are then read back one at a time by seek plus read_exact and parsed on demand. The parallel index build exists (Index::build is generic over CHUNKS, tested up to 32) but from_path hard-codes CHUNKS=1.
